'''Janus Greejatus's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]] and the father of [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]], who would become a member of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He held a deep [[Humanocentrism|hatred]] of non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]], as his family fortune had been whittled away by them.
